subject: Marine Works - Chaleur - Miscou - south - Escuminac
text:
Marine Works - Chaleur - Miscou - south - Escuminac
Dredging operations underway in Escuminac small craft harbour from 23 September until December 31, 2026. Operations will take place during daylight hours, 7 days a week. A tug, work barges and scows will be operating in the area. Caution
